facts.value: Queries the Fighter's x508 color-animation representation with the literal expression `(int) &fp->x508.x28_colanim.ptr->x7B`, without loading the x7B byte or mutating state. Dispatcher subtraction of 0x7B and integer-arm installation support intended reconstruction of a reserved global color-animation ID; a consumer tests 0x7B and 0x80. Exact compiled member displacement, pointer/integer representation, and behavior for null or invalid pointer representations remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Replace unconditional arithmetic semantics with verified literal behavior and separately qualified intended meaning.

evidence.why: Reserved ID normalization and x508 routing.

facts.value: Scans the sole wind record by null Ground marker. A free record receives all three unchecked arguments, ft_804D6578.x0 increments, and the function returns; an occupied record reports and asserts without replacement. Null Ground input still increments while leaving the slot free, so count and occupancy can diverge and count-driven traversal can exceed capacity. Null callbacks are accepted. Reset clears the count and Ground marker but leaves type and callback unchanged. No count saturation or signed-overflow protection is provided.
facts.rationale: Correct the implicit empty-to-occupied guarantee and document actual boundary behavior.

evidence.why: Unchecked insertion, count increment, reset, and overflow path.
Consumer trusts count and invokes retained callback without callback-null validation.

facts.value: Scans two catch slots in ascending order and stores the three unchecked arguments in the first null-object record, increments ftDevice_BuryThingCount once, and returns. Both occupied records cause reporting and assertion without replacement. Null Ground input leaves the chosen slot free despite incrementing the count; null callbacks and duplicate objects are not rejected. Reset clears both object markers and the count, not discriminator or callback payloads. Count-driven consumers require valid registrations to keep the count within two. No count saturation or signed-overflow protection is provided.
facts.rationale: Remove the unsupported non-null stored-object guarantee and expose consumer bounds preconditions.

evidence.why: First-fit writes, reset, unchecked arguments, increment, and assertion.

facts.value: Uses the sole collision record's Ground marker as the free predicate. A free record receives all three unchecked arguments, ft_804D6570 increments, and the function returns; an occupied record reports collision overflow and asserts without replacement. Null Ground input increments while leaving the record free, permitting count/occupancy divergence and out-of-bounds count-driven traversal. Null callbacks are accepted. Reset clears marker and count but preserves discriminator and callback. No count saturation or signed-overflow protection is provided.
facts.rationale: Qualify the one-slot state machine for actual unchecked inputs rather than assuming successful insertion occupies it.

evidence.why: Unchecked tuple insertion and full-record assertion.
